summary: The site's robots.txt disallows the directory that holds the account sign-in page, so the page was not captured, and no other public source shows the form.
lookedFor: robots.txt of www.marcaria.com: for every agent it has Disallow: /register/, and none of its Allow lines covers /register/user/login.asp, the catalog sign-in address. The capture tool was therefore not run and the page was not read in any other way.
A code search on GitHub for the sign-in address: this repository's own catalog, and one invoice collector that only names the site as planned and has no selector.
neededFromUser: The sign-in page saved from the user's own browser as "Webpage, Complete" and read with the capture tool's --from-file mode. That would make this class A. Save any page signed out and with no password typed in; keep the "_files" folder beside the .html and both outside the repository: they can hold the account name.
